p1: The Preacher loved the morning sun. He wrote, “Truly the light is sweet. It is a happy thing to see the sun.”
Then he wrote, “Remember now your Creator in the days of your youth.” Remember the One who made you while you are young, like right now!
Heavenly Father is the Father of your spirit, the you that thinks and loves. Jesus made this world for Him.
p2: Last, the Preacher said the most important thing. Love and honor Heavenly Father. Keep His commandments, His loving rules that keep us safe and happy.
You do not have to wait to grow up. Tonight, thank Heavenly Father for the sun, and for making you.
old: The wise teacher of Ecclesiastes had one very special piece of advice, just for young people like you.
“Remember Heavenly Father now, while you are young!” he said. Don’t wait until you’re big and grown up — start loving Him today.
When we’re little, our hearts are soft and ready to learn, like fresh soil ready for seeds. It’s the perfect time to plant love for Heavenly Father deep inside.
Every prayer you say, every story you hear, every kind thing you do helps you know Heavenly Father better — right now, while you’re small.
You don’t have to wait to be a friend of Heavenly Father. You can start today, and grow closer to Him every single day of your happy life.
